spanish: Estos cabezas de casa de sus padres: hijos de Rubén primogénito de Israel: Janoc y Palú, Jetsrón y Carmí; estas familias de Rubén.
grammarChanges: Kept the masculine demonstrative "Estos" with "cabezas" unchanged: when "cabeza" denotes a male head of household (as here, patriarchal heads), standard Spanish licenses masculine agreement on the determiner despite the noun's feminine form (cf. "el/los cabeza de familia"); switching to "estas cabezas" was not required and was not made.
readerNote: Kept masculine "Estos cabezas" rather than "estas cabezas": this is the licensed Spanish agreement pattern when "cabeza" refers to male heads of household, so no repair was needed for the cited warning.
